name: opening
does: The first load's start: `old`, the bedroom as the loading cover (the creator); `bedroom` (or `chart`, its old name) forces the wake-up in her bedroom, the default since Ed, 2026-10-23 (the tuning's `opening.bedroom`; the sea chart came first from 2026-10-21 till then). A link naming a seed or island wakes her in her bedroom too (Ed, 2026-10-25); one starting a bot game or the zoo, or with `creator=0`, keeps the old start anyway; the tools that drive the old start (the creator, the start card) put `opening=old` in their links.
decision: The sea chart opening is the default (2026-10-21)
